author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
AI bubble peak market research, I ask everyone I come across on how much money their companies spend on AI. Here are two new random data point

1. A local college, with 1000 staff, they have M365 Copilot subscription for a while, just introducing Claude, monthly subscription. Most staff are still using the chat based AI

2. A med size real estate company, Claude monthly subscription, the workers there just starting to learn how to automate their Excel and emails.

comments.text: it's the part of learning curve. We are still in the hype cycle.
